newsitem.title: USA: Atkinson says unit wins $297.7 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Atkinson says unit wins $297.7 mln contract.

text.p: Atkinson said Monday that its operating unit, Atkinson Construction Co, was awarded a $297.7 million contract from the Massachusetts Highway Department and the Massachusetts Bay Transportation Authority for a project expected to run through June 2003.
The company said in a release that the project calls for construction of a portion of Interstate 90 in the South Boston area.

The construction will run from the South Boston Haul Road to D Street and North of Sumner Street, as well as construction of the Massachusetts Bay Transportation Authority's World Trade Center Station South Boston, Atkinson said.
Construction is scheduled to begin in February 1997, with completion planned for June 2003, it said.
